Mapping the store and its purchase funnel

I registered four pages: home, product, cart and checkout. That covers the purchase funnel end to end, including `/cart.html` and `/checkout.html`, which the crawl only reached through JavaScript navigation (`onclick`). The crawl found no category or account pages.

Parallel audit: one page-auditor per page
I've started four page-auditor agents in parallel, one each for the home, product, cart and checkout pages. They're still running, so I have no results yet.

# a11y: EAA / WCAG 2.1 AA remediation for maison-lumiere.fr

Branch `a11y/eaa-remediation-2026-10-15` → `main` (2026-10-15)

## Summary

- **Accessibility score: 38 → 93.** EAA status: **partially compliant**.
- 18 issues found across `/`, `/product.html`, `/cart.html` and `/checkout.html`. **16 fixed and verified**, **2 escalated to a human** (see "Needs human review").
- axe violations: 34 → 0. Unreachable controls: 8 → 0. Elements with visible focus: 0/56 → 64/64.

## Fixes by WCAG criterion

### 1.1.1 Non-text Content (A), commit `3c57c44`
- **A03**: Cart and product-card images now have `alt=""`. They are decorative because the product name sits next to each one.

### 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A), commit `4daa088`
- **A13**: The cart table has a visually hidden caption, a `thead` with `th scope="col"`, and a shared `.sr-only` class.
- **A18**: The hero title is now an `h1` and the product card titles are `h2`. CSS selectors were updated so the look is unchanged.

### 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA), commit `a390920`
- **A01**: Light grey text is now `#666666` (≥5.4:1) for `.hero p`, `.price-note`, `.site-footer` and its links.

### 2.1.1 Keyboard (A), commit `c444aeb`
- **A04**: Size choices are now native buttons.
- **A05**: The add-to-cart and pay controls are now native buttons, with a CSS reset to keep the look.
- **A06**: The "Commander" span is now a real link to `checkout.html`.

### 2.4.2 Page Titled (A), commit `c22ad70`
- **A17**: The checkout title is now "Paiement — Maison Lumière".

### 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context) (A), commit `5094f12`
- **A16**: Each "En savoir plus" link has an `aria-label` that starts with the visible text and adds the product name.

### 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA), commit `dda8290`
- **A02**: Removed the global `*:focus { outline: none; }`. Added a visible 3px blue `:focus-visible` outline in the shared stylesheet.

### 3.1.1 Language of Page (A), commit `9bd555a`
- **A08**: Added `lang="fr"` to `index.html`.

### 3.3.1 Error Identification (A), commit `f11c285`
- **A14**: The invalid email field now has `aria-invalid` and a visible error message linked with `aria-describedby`. `pay()` validation keeps them in sync.

### 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A), commit `9aac137`
- **A10**: Added visually hidden labels (`sr-only`) and `autocomplete` tokens to all checkout fields, with no visual change.

### 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A), commit `eadf3d9`
- **A07**: Header buttons have `aria-label`s (Rechercher, Favoris, "Panier, 2 articles", which includes the visible count). `shop.js` keeps the cart label in sync.
- **A11**: Quantity and remove buttons have `aria-label`s naming the action and the product.
- **A12**: Sizes are buttons with `aria-pressed`, updated by `selectSize`.

## Needs human review

| ID | WCAG | Issue | Action required | Owner |
|----|------|-------|-----------------|-------|
| A09 | 1.1.1 | Product photo has a useless alt text (`alt="image"` on `product.html`) | Write an alt text describing what `img/sneaker.svg` shows (colour, material, view) and replace `alt="image"`. The agent can't see the photo, and the page doesn't give its colour or view. | Merchandising team |
| A15 | 1.3.1 | Third-party payment frame cannot be verified | The card fields are a PayVite widget that we don't own. PayVite, or whoever integrates it, must supply a version with real labels (`label`/`aria-label` on each input, `autocomplete` attributes) and accessible error messages. Then the compliance team must re-verify it. | PayVite / the integrator, then the compliance team |

## How this was verified

- Each page was scanned with axe-core (WCAG 2.1 A/AA rules) before and after the changes: 34 violations → 0.
- A keyboard walk on each page checked focus order, accessible names, visible focus and unreachable controls: 8 unreachable → 0, and visible focus 0/56 → 64/64.
- Each fix was reviewed by an agent and marked validated. A07, A11 and A12 needed a second attempt before they were accepted.
- Limits: the agent review can't judge image content (A09), and the third-party payment frame is outside our code (A15). Both are open above.

# Accessibility Statement — maison-lumiere.fr

*Draft, dated 2026-10-15.*

Maison Lumière is committed to making maison-lumiere.fr accessible, in line with the European Accessibility Act (EAA).

## Compliance status

This website is **partially compliant** with WCAG 2.1 level AA and EN 301 549, because of the non-compliances listed below.

## Non-accessible content

1. **Product photo alternative text (WCAG 1.1.1, EN 301 549 9.1.1.1)**: On the product page, the main product photo has a non-descriptive alternative text ("image"). Screen reader users do not get a description of the product. A description of the photo still has to be written by the merchandising team.
2. **Third-party payment widget (WCAG 1.3.1, EN 301 549 9.1.3.1)**: The card fields on the checkout page come from a third-party provider, PayVite, and we do not control them. We could not verify that they have proper labels, autocomplete attributes and accessible error messages. We are asking the provider or integrator for a compliant version, which will then be re-verified.

## Assessment approach

- The site was assessed on 2026-10-15 against WCAG 2.1 level AA and EN 301 549.
- Assessment used automated testing (axe-core) and agent-based review, including keyboard navigation checks.
- Pages covered: home (`/`), product (`/product.html`), cart (`/cart.html`) and checkout (`/checkout.html`).
- Of 18 issues found, 16 have been fixed and verified. The 2 above remain open.
- This assessment has not been confirmed by a manual audit with assistive technologies or by an independent third party.

## Feedback and contact

We welcome feedback on the accessibility of this website.

- Contact: [TO COMPLETE]
- Response time: [TO COMPLETE]

## Enforcement procedure

If you are not satisfied with our reply, you can contact the competent national enforcement authority.

- Authority name and contact details: [TO COMPLETE]

## Date of this statement

2026-10-15
